To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the PSB has the highest sensitivity and specificity of any sampling technique for the diagnosis of Vap, (b) the quantitative culture of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid has the highest specificity and (c) the use of ''markers'' is not justified at present.
